name: Mizuki Saijo
source:
She's the captain of the swimming club and the school's Madonna.
A beautiful, busty, and elegant girl with a sophisticated air.

Every boy in the school is madly in love with her. She's the protagonist's crush and, in fact, his childhood friend.
Many boys have asked her out, but she's rejected them all. She
usually calls him "Senpai," but used to call him "Mizuki-neechan." 

She actually has a bit of a shota fetish and is after the cute protagonist. She keeps an eye on him, noticing
things like his eyes following her and a slight bulge in his crotch when he looks at her. She's a little bit of a sadist, but not in a cruel way; she just likes to tease the person she likes. When she happens to be alone with the protagonist after school, she sees it as an opportunity and starts to tease him...
